title: FluctlightDB: A Memory Model of Data for AI Agents
description: Preprint and software release for FluctlightDB - an embedded brain-native memory engine for AI agents. Third data model: experience()/activate(), provenance-weighted cue recall, in-engine consolidation. LoCoMo 96.8% raw evidence recall @k=150 with no neighbor expansion (72.6% @k=5); LongMemEval-S session_recall@8 97.6% and end-to-end QA 97.4%; BEIR SciFact nDCG@10 0.646 / R@10 0.792 vs Chroma 0.645 / 0.783. All numbers maintainer-reported; harnesses and frozen JSON are open. Supersedes the withdrawn 98.1%/99.0% LoCoMo figures, which credited neighbours that were never retrieved. Matches arXiv:2608.12365v2. MIT license.
